selection.ownership: BotStar / BOTSTAR VIET NAM LIMITED COMPANY (CÔNG TY TNHH BOTSTAR VIỆT NAM), Da Nang, Vietnam; founders Huy Dinh and Tuong Le. English SaaS at botstar.com and apis.botstar.com. Vietnam is not mainland China; this is the global Public API edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official BotStar account profile token generation (https://app.botstar.com/account/profile), pinned Public API v1 at https://apis.botstar.com/v1 (Bearer, GET /bots/, GET /bots/{id}, GET /bots/{id}/attributes, GET /bots/{id}/cms_entities), CMS product docs, Da Nang Vietnam operator, and dated incident search (BotStar + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved BotStar compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

BotStar Public API v1 is a fixed-host Bearer API at apis.botstar.com. Official REST OpenAPI is not published as a standalone reference; token minting is documented on the BotStar account profile, and GET /v1/bots is corroborated by Pipedream and Quickwork. Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found no qualifying unresolved BotStar compromise. Vietnamese ownership does not make this a mainland-China edition.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

livechat.boot.title: Boot livechat widget
livechat.boot.description: Validate a BotStar livechat appId (bot id) and optionally update the audience user. Server equivalent of BotStarApi('boot').

user.description: Audience user attributes to load or update during boot.

block.description: Starting block ID in the chatbot flow.

variables.description: Custom variables (string keys to string or number values).

users.get.title: Get audience user
users.get.description: Get a BotStar audience user by bot ID and user ID. Also used for BOTSTAR_WEBVIEW_GET_PARAMETER when the named value is stored on the user.

parameter_name.description: Optional Composio BOTSTAR_WEBVIEW_GET_PARAMETER field name to read from the user object.

users.update.title: Update audience user
users.update.description: Update BotStar audience user attributes. Server equivalent of BotStarApi('update').

tags.description: Tags to set on the user. Replaces current tags.

additional_attributes.description: Custom user attributes keyed by field name.

webview.send-response.title: Send webview response
webview.send-response.description: Send webview outputs back to the BotStar chatbot via the documented graph.botstar.com webview endpoint (BotStarWebview sendResponse).

response.description: Value to send back to the BotStar chatbot.

outputs.description: Outputs keyed by bs:output meta tag names. Values must be string or number.

outlet_name.description: Outlet name matching a bs:outlet meta tag.
